text:
jamal: Heads-up — I can view full org billing breakdown (per-customer, per-route) from a sandbox user. repro steps:
1) Login as sandbox@acme
2) Open /console/billing -> Cost breakdown

Response shows 200 with detailed cost fields. This looks like an RBAC regression after last night's permission refactor. @irene can you take a look? :eyes:

irene: grabbing logs now. which commit did the refactor?

jamal: it was 8f3a2d (rbac/refactor/billing-perms). PR removed billing_viewer role and mapped billing.view -> analytics.read in the compatibility shim. snippet from the old/high-level mapping: 
```
- role: analytics_reader
  permissions: ["analytics.read", "usage.read"]
- role: billing_viewer
  permissions: ["billing.view"]
```
PR changed it to only use analytics.read for multiple surfaces.

mike: if analytics.read now grants route-level cost visibility, that's a broaden. we need to audit any role that got mapped to analytics.read. mitigation: hide the UI cost breakdown for non-admins until fixed. @sara can you flip a flag?

sara: on it. creating feature-flag: `hide_cost_breakdown_for_non_admins`. toggling it OFF in prod while we triage. will push console patch in ~30m.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for console patch -> prod-us-1

irene: logs show request from user sandbox@acme id=usr_97abc with token tk_zzz. auth check used new policy: `has_permission('analytics.read')` and the billing endpoint mistakenly treated analytics.read as sufficient for cost_read. I'm putting an explicit gate to require `billing.view` for cost endpoints. Opening a hotfix PR now.

jamal: filing vuln ticket P1 (sec-2026-042). attaching audit logs + repro. Also thinking about KMS: billing export keys are used by the pipeline — we should confirm no key decrypt perms were granted to the sandbox role. @mike please verify KMS perms and rotate if anything looks off.

mike: checking KMS IAM and CMKs. I'll verify key policy, service account bindings, and recent decrypt/grant logs. if anomalous, we'll rotate and update rotation job.

irene: PR #4523 created: adds explicit `billing.view` check, writes an audit event on authorization decision, and tightens shim mappings. Also added unit tests for endpoint-level auth. moving to code review and will request an emergency rollout.

sara: patch built, canary passed basic smoke. feature flag remains off for prod. monitoring dashboards showing no successful non-admin hits to the cost endpoint in last 5m.

ops-oncall: escalated to sec-oncall for SOC review and external impact assessment.

jamal: thanks — please keep updates here. we should also prepare a short customer-facing blurb if anyone outside org had visibility. for now mark as internal-only P1 and keep audit trail. :lock:
